audit.intent: Preserve Recraft’s humanist asymmetry, slight stroke lean and curvature. Reflection differences are measurements for visual review, not a command to mirror. Straight edges are enforced only in explicitly declared regions; natural near-horizontal/vertical curves remain curves. Reviewed stroke/bowl junctions are named intentional corners. Tall ascenders and terminal rhythm are part of this unapproved design.
